messages:
ana: Heads-up: next week were launching 'Audit Vault / Escrow Access' for Private/VPC customers. Purpose: provide a sealed, time-limited, verifiable export for regulators or legal counsel with chain-of-custody attestation. Opt-in + signed addendum required.

ana: Key differences from previous exports: requires agent v3.3+, artifacts stored in a read-only sealed-vault (temporary presigned storage), includes a signed custody ledger (verifiable ledger entry for each handoff), and supports three redaction levels: minimal, standard, full.

ana: Canary plan: Tue 09:30Z (8 tenants) -> broad Wed. Defaults: retention 14 days in vault, 2 concurrent exports/tenant, 20GB max per artifact (support chunking), rate limit 5 exports/hour.

raj: Ops notes: adding vault_upload_latency and vault_inflight metrics. We'll expose a per-tenant "pause escrow" toggle in Console. Also adding a throttle override for support staff (audited).

attest-bot: deploy-schedule: escrow handlers canary 2026-09-14T09:30Z -> 2026-09-14T11:30Z. Auto-rollback if error rate > 0.9%.

donna: Security: artifacts HSM-signed and include a custody manifest with SHA256 checksums and a signed timestamp. We'll also generate an "export fingerprint" customers can pin. Key rotation: semi-annual. Infra to publish verification endpoint.

infra: Action: publish the public verification key and a small verification CLI. Also add support for tenant-managed KMS wrapping keys for vault artifacts.

legal: Draft addendum path: /legal/drafts/escrow-access-addendum.md. Legal requires admin identity capture + countersignature for any artifact that includes telemetry. Permanent retention requests require commercial contract amendment.

ana: Customer example (request via Console API):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants/ORG/escrow" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"since":"2026-04-01T00:00:00Z","redaction_level":"standard","include_telemetry":false,"retention_days":14}'
```

cs_eng: CS notes: we'll need a short checklist for customers: required addendum, admin ident proof, expected delivery windows, and instructions to validate signatures and ledger entries. I'll schedule two office hours and need a demo tenant.

ana: SLA note: exports run on control-plane resources and are background, best-effort. Expected windows: <=12h for <1GB, <=48h for larger up to 20GB. Expedited legal-hold path available via a signed legal token (separate addendum). No change to inference SLOs.

raj: Ops runbook items: how to abort/retry escrow jobs, how to reassemble chunked artifacts, verifying export fingerprint, and emergency throttle knob. Also add preflight to agent upgrade to warn about low disk.

infra: We'll add an optional verification CLI snippet for customers to check the HSM signature and ledger entry. Example verify command will be added to docs.

legal: Please do not enable any telemetry-inclusive escrow exports until my team signs the addendum and updates the consent wording.

donna: Security ack. I'll coordinate the verification endpoint and publish the key.

raj: Ops ack. I'll add metrics and the console pause button.

cs_eng: Ack. I'll prepare customer materials and request the demo tenant.

ana: Thanks everyone. Please ack when your action items are done. If you want to rehearse a customer demo DM me. :lock_with_ink_pen:
